title: Coherence of explicit restricted fixed-coefficient single complexes
statement: Let W and S be schemes, k:W→S, F an abelian sheaf on the small etale site of W [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], I any small category, D₀:I→Over W and c₀ any cone, and U→S etale. Define D(i)=U×_S D₀(i), with transition maps rawAffineRestrictedMap [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology], and c=U×_S c₀. Put K_i=(pr_i^* D₀(i).hom^*F)[0]. Define the transition isomorphism explicitly using mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor and the three inverse-image composition comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition] around the triangle (see restrictedOverSingleIso). Let phi be its hom. Let G be the constant diagram on K(c₀.pt), and eG_i the inverse of the cone-leg transition isomorphism. Then phi satisfies the identity and composition laws, and G satisfies the cone comparison equation displayed in lean.statement. The parameters D,c,K,phi,G,eG are required by equality or HEq to be these explicit constructions. No limit, affine, cofiltered, boundedness, cohomology, or continuity hypothesis or conclusion occurs.

proof.text: First prove the canonical coherence statement in a private, fully proved helper. Apply restrictedOverSingle_unit at each object, and restrictedOverSingle_composition to the three functor image arrows using map_comp. For the cone law apply the same composition theorem to c₀.π_j and D₀.map(f), with the named composite c₀.π_i supplied by cone naturality. The generic categorical lemma iso_cancel_triangle precomposes this equality with the inverse of the transition isomorphism for c₀.π_i and uses inv_hom_id. Since G is constant and eG is the inverse leg isomorphism, the result is exactly the cone equation. Finally substitute D and eliminate each HEq for c,K,phi,G,eG; apply the fully proved canonical helper. This equality transport is the only use of the concrete-data hypotheses.
